Publication statement: New York : J.T. Lloyd, 1864.

Relief shown by hachures. "Entered according to Act of Congress in the year 1864 by J. T. Lloyd, in the clerk's office of the Dist. Court of the U.S. for the 8th n Dist. of New York." "Price in sheets colored in counties 50 cents. Mounted and varnished $1.00. Pocket Edn. with Union backs $200[sic], sent free by mail." Hand-colored general map with places where battles occurred underlined in red. Another copy is in Fillmore map coll. No. 110-W. The Geography and Map Division also has an uncolored copy (copyright no. 169, April 30, 1864). Description derived from published bibliography. LC Civil War maps (2nd ed.), 129.65 Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
